status: CONDITIONAL STUDY INPUTS; NOT QUALIFIED PROCESS, GEOMETRY OR LOAD EVIDENCE
process_cases: evidence/e16/process-cases.json cases (rho, foil, barrel plating); their lumped wire_plus_termination_ohm is NOT used here

uniform-dielectric.basis: Conditional default: authored six 2 oz foils on 1.6 mm (design/boards/osc-core.json, which records no dielectric thickness) with the remaining 1.18 mm split equally. No 2 oz six-layer stackup with dielectric thicknesses is published (process-evidence-20261013.json I1).

barrel-upper-1p6-per-interval.basis: Sensitivity only: every tap-to-tap barrel interval charged the full 1.6 mm board thickness. No physical interval can be longer, so this bounds each barrel interval's resistance from above; it overcharges more than the 2026-10-13 partial model (which charged 1.6 mm per face-to-plane leg) whenever a barrel also taps non-functional annuli.

staged-caps-bands.basis: Sensitivity only: staged_caps.BANDS, the rejected V14/V15 staged-model stack (0.05 mm outer dielectrics that contradict published limits, e16-construction-contract.json). connectivity.py uses these bands only to decide which foils a drill crosses, which is the same for every E16 through via; it is not an authored E16 stack. It puts In2/In3 far from each other and near the faces.

wires.basis: evidence/electrical-design.json finite_current_field: generic85mm_wire_bulk_plus_this_termination_mOhm 1.180953 = 85 mm x 13 mOhm/m bulk requirement (1.105) + combined_termination_upper_mOhm 0.075953 for BOTH ends (energy_formula 'For both ends'). The per-board lump would charge the bulk and both ends twice in a joined model; here bulk is charged once per wire and each end's termination once on its own board.
wires.status: Requirement-class values, not measured or qualified wire/termination resistance. The 110 mm maximum cut (1.43 mOhm bulk) is evaluated as an all-present sensitivity in each coupled result.

source_support.basis: Conditional: the load-side star is unimplemented (CN301/XB301 abstract; no inlet copper). The fed KA main lands of each net (branches to JL/JR/P) are held at one source potential over their whole land patches, standing in for an ideal load-side star at those lands. No upstream AWG14 section, raw-to-load bridge or protection path is modelled; branch currents to JL/JR/P are external and not injected.

scenario.injected: supported_pin_current and conditional_assumption records with a numeric current on a pad of this board/net
scenario.not_injected: external_interface_demand (EL group ceiling: no per-pad split is supported), unmapped_allowance, and every no_amount record
scenario.producer: python3 load_ledger.py --output DIR (deterministic; --check rebuilds and compares)
scenario.scope: Complete-device quiescent subset only; no full electrical acceptance

local_ground: For a rail pad of device R: the mean potential over R's own fed AGND pad supports; if R has none, the nearest fed AGND pad on the same board by pad-centre distance (conditional definition).

budgets.source: design/partition/core-split/power/contract.json conductor_screen.global_budget and power/joined/handoff.md: one global 20 mV path allowance, 1 mOhm rail and 0.5 mOhm common AGND copper, never restarted per board; 0.5 A per GH conductor.
budgets.application: Charged once over the modelled KA+wire+KB path; the unmodelled inlet/star, branch and protection copper must fit in the same allowance, so a modelled value within budget is necessary, not sufficient.

numerical_tolerances.declared: 2026-10-13, before any coupled result was inspected

error_convention: error_V = (V_rail(pad) - V_AGND(local ground)) - (V_rail(source) - V_AGND(source)); both nets are referenced to 0 V at the source, so error_V = V_rail(pad) - V_AGND(local). It is the deviation of the supply voltage the device actually sees, signed; on -12V a local ground rise partly cancels a rail rise. The additive magnitude screen in power/joined/handoff.md (|rail drop| + |ground rise|) is reported alongside as a conservative bound.
